catalogue_identity_provenance.interpretation: The historical migrations map all 45 model files to unique gift codes. The current connected Supabase live_gift_catalog snapshot returned zero rows for these 45 codes. Historical seed values are provenance only, not current production prices or activation.

technical_audit_summary.conclusion: All 45 standalone glTF model files have POSITION accessor min/max bounds recomputed against the embedded float32 vertex data. The files contain no texture/image assets or embedded animation channels. Accessor-local bounds are recorded; world-space dimensions remain unverified because node transforms have not been applied.

limitations: Accessor-local bounds do not include scene-node transforms; world-space dimensions were not calculated.
No screenshot or device renderer review was performed by this structural audit.
No material, lighting, texture, or artistic premium approval is implied.
No legacy model was mapped to or activated in the production gift catalogue.
